question:
Choose the idiom/phrase that can substitute the highlighted group of words meaningfully.

Finally, everything is **in public knowledge** and now people will decide the outcome.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Out in the open"** means something that is no longer hidden or secret; it has been made public. (खुली जगह में)

 
 
• **Example: **After the news was **out in the open**, everyone started discussing it.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Break a leg** (गुड लक कहना): A way to wish someone good luck, especially before a performance.

 
 
• **Example:** Before the play started, the director told the cast to break a leg.
 
 
 
• **Through thick and thin** (सभी परिस्थितियों में): Under all circumstances, no matter how difficult.
 
 
• **Example:** They remained friends through thick and thin.
 
 
 
• **Bright spark** (चतुर व्यक्ति): A clever or witty person.
 
 
• **Example:** He's a bright spark; he always comes up with great ideas.
 
 

34:Taea,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
